parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station Choba-LawnTennisField (Lawn Tennis Field, University of Port Harcourt, Choba Town). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 91.2 | 2.535 | 2.535
2 | 380.2 | 15.83 | 18.37
3 | 43.25 | 20.36 | 38.73
4 | 474.3 | 33.05 | 71.78
5 | 597.1 | - | -

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: Choba-LawnTennisField
Curve type: KHA-type
Aquifer depth: 38.73 m – 71.78 m (with a deeper aquiferous zone likely continuing below 71.78 m)
Recommendation: Target drilling and well screen placement within the 38.73–71.78 m high-resistivity sandy interval, which represents the main aquifer; ensure proper casing/sealing through the overlying low-resistivity clayey layer (18.37–38.73 m) to prevent cross-contamination, and consider deepening the borehole to assess the underlying high-resistivity layer (>71.78 m) as a potential secondary aquifer.
